nodes.label: mustRotate / needsSection Custom Claims
nodes.rationale: Compared with === true so absent/null claims never read as done; the pincode never opens a session.

nodes.label: freshEmailVerified Live Gate
nodes.rationale: Live Admin read instead of cookie claim because magic-link flows flip emailVerified without re-signing the user in.

nodes.label: resendVerification (custom token -> VERIFY_EMAIL)
nodes.rationale: Server never holds password or refresh token, so it mints an idToken via createCustomToken -> signInWithCustomToken.

nodes.label: __session HttpOnly Session Cookie (5-day)
nodes.rationale: No idToken/refresh token in JS; checkRevoked:true on every read so password change, activation or global sign-out kills cookies.

nodes.label: siteBaseUrl (lib/site-url.ts)
nodes.rationale: Host header never used because it is client-controlled and links carry sign-in codes.

nodes.label: Appendix B: Resend DNS Records
nodes.rationale: DKIM/SPF/DMARC records missing in live DNS; Resend API reports verified from stale cache.

nodes.label: Firebase Identity Toolkit (sole identity authority)
nodes.rationale: App never hashes/stores/compares passwords; one hashing impl, salt policy and brute-force protection, all Google's.

nodes.label: Claim Magic-Link Flow (startClaim/openClaimLink/completeClaim)
nodes.rationale: Only way to reclaim an old-directory profile; eligibility checked at send and completion time since state may change.

nodes.label: rateLimits hashKey 60s Cooldown
nodes.rationale: Hashed doc ids so no raw emails at rest.

nodes.label: Claim OTP -> Firebase Magic Link Redesign
nodes.norm_label: claim otp -> firebase magic link redesign

nodes.label: Phase 0: Switch Auth Email to Firebase
nodes.norm_label: phase 0: switch auth email to firebase
nodes.rationale: All-Firebase auth email; Resend kept only for the broadcast page.

nodes.label: Phase 4: Self Sign-up Join Panel
nodes.rationale: No roll at signup, so no roll-squatting; roll reserved only at profile creation.

nodes.label: Anti-Enumeration Uniform Responses
nodes.rationale: Claim and reset return one response whether or not the account exists; reasons only in masked [auth] logs. Sign-up inherently reveals registration.

nodes.label: Compensating Rollback (releaseRoll + deleteProfileDoc)
nodes.rationale: Auth account deliberately stays because it owns the session.

nodes.label: Series Registry (SeriesConfig, types/series.ts)
nodes.rationale: Registry is data: adding a series is one entry, no code; roll formats/section counts vary per series.

nodes.label: seriesFromRoll (series derived from roll)
nodes.rationale: Series is never user or route input; stored field exists only for querying; profiles can never change series via roll edit.

nodes.label: Environment Variables (NEXT_PUBLIC_FIREBASE_*, FIREBASE_ADMIN_*)
nodes.rationale: Admin keys unprefixed so they are never bundled into the client.

nodes.label: firestore.rules validProfile (series field)
nodes.rationale: Rules are a structural guard; zod does precise validation because rules can't import the registry.

nodes.label: Admin SDK Single Write Path
nodes.rationale: firestore.rules is defense-in-depth; Admin SDK bypasses it so server actions are the single write path.
